title: Board widget
description: Widget catalogue imported from the [[widgets]] of module manifests (decision 0021). Boards read it to build templates and iframe URLs; the owning module renders the widget and checks its permission. Never a grant.

permission.description: Permission the module checks for this widget; shown to template authors, not enforced by the board.

url.description: Same-host path including the app path, e.g. /maintenance/widgets/open-tasks.

options.description: Option name -> {type: enum|int|number|bool|string|list, default, values?, value_labels?, value_icons?, choices?, min?, max?, max_length?, label?, group?, when?}. choices is the same-host path of the module endpoint that lists the values for a board context.

actions.description: True when the widget writes (e.g. prints a label).

retired.description: Set by the portal when a re-imported manifest no longer declares this version.
